## Skill checklist (if adding/editing a skill)

- [ ] `SKILL.md` has frontmatter with `name` and `description`

- [ ] Workflow section is concrete and actionable
- [ ] At least one `## Example` invocation included
- [ ] `Don'ts` section lists what the skill should refuse or avoid
- [ ] Tested locally against `uisato/ableton-mcp-extended` (or note which server)
